verified_contracts.contract: Suppression diagnostics are one bounded record per rejected candidate
verified_contracts.evidence: news_bot._log_dedup_subject_suppression uses a fixed parameterized template; both URL identifiers are capped at 200 characters, sources at 50, titles at 160, series at 180, and the diagnostic list is capped upstream. The hostile-field regression passed.

verified_contracts.contract: Log-injection and secret-bearing external values are sanitized before interpolation
verified_contracts.evidence: The suppression path removes control characters, URL userinfo, query strings, and fragments, percent-encodes ambiguous identifier characters, applies shared token/key redaction plus configured-secret replacement, and substitutes constant markers for oversized or unrepresentable values.

verified_contracts.contract: Broad and capped E014 logs do not expose pair-overlap percentages
verified_contracts.evidence: Only reason=overlap uses the legacy percentage log branch. broad_subject and overlap_capped use sanitized identifiers and sources with an explicit fixed reason; the integration regressions passed.

Suppression logging and telemetry execute inside the existing dedup try/except boundary. A preparation, formatting, logger, match-shape, or database failure therefore follows E016 degraded mode and stages without a fingerprint rather than hard-blocking the article.

verified_contracts.contract: Telegram review authorization, token kind, callback grammar, and pair throttling are unchanged
verified_contracts.evidence: The new reason fields are keyword-only alert-builder inputs. Token creation still stores REVIEW_TOKEN_KIND_DEDUP, keyboard callbacks remain dd:c:<token> and dd:k:<token>, the existing listener authorization gate is untouched, and the same link pair is marked through mark_pair_pinged. The contract regression passed.

pytest passed 3/3 focused tests: suppression log redaction/bounds/single-line behavior, per-candidate diagnostics with article-unit telemetry, and E014 rate-limit/review-token preservation. git diff --check also passed.

residual_risks.risk: Legacy ordinary-overlap E014 and E015 log branches still interpolate article identifiers directly.
residual_risks.assessment: Pre-existing and unchanged by Task 3. The new broad, capped, and suppression paths are sanitized as required; hardening the legacy branches would be a separate logging-safety scope.

residual_risks.risk: Suppression logging is intentionally capped at the upstream maximum of 100 candidate records per incoming article.
residual_risks.assessment: This bounds memory and log volume, but diagnostics beyond the cap are omitted by design. The article-level telemetry still records that suppression occurred.
